name: Space Kommand
author: korhadris
description: Command a starship in space combat: manage its heading and speed, check its systems and fire at enemy ships.

descriptions.en: Command a starship in space combat: manage its heading and speed, check its systems and fire at enemy ships.
descriptions.it: Comanda un'astronave in battaglia: gestisci rotta e velocità, controlla i sistemi di bordo e fai fuoco sulle navi nemiche.
